description: Implement weapon drop physics with gravity, floor collision, and map collision. Editor objects already have collision in PlaytestMode.
steps: Added mapColliders field and setMapColliders() to Combat
dropWeapon() gives initial throw velocity based on camera direction
update() replaces floating animation with gravity + floor + wall collision
Game.ts and PlaytestMode.ts wire up mapColliders
acceptance_criteria: Dropped weapons fall to the ground with gravity
Players can walk through dropped weapons
Editor objects already have collision (confirmed existing implementation)
verification: npx vite build exits with code 0
findings: Physics simulation with gravity (15 m/s^2), floor collision at y=0.1, horizontal map collision using Box3, and friction damping. Editor collision was already implemented in PlaytestMode.ts addColliders().
